name: Violin: the first movement of the Sibelius Violin Concerto
description: Here's the opening movement of the Sibelius Violin Concerto in D minor, a thirteen-minute concert piece played by a violinist from our string quartet.
more: For your event, our string players have a song list that runs from classical preludes and processionals to hymns, love songs, pop and film themes, all arranged for strings. Strings are lovely at a memorial service, too, where we can play Ave Maria, Amazing Grace and the hymns your family chooses.
